gloss: smooth sweet bean paste; strained red bean paste

definitions.gloss: smooth sweet bean paste; strained red bean paste
definitions.explanation: Sweet red bean paste (あんこ) that has been strained to remove the bean skins, resulting in a completely smooth, fine-textured paste.

examples.japanese: こしあん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought yokan made with smooth bean paste.

examples.japanese: こしあん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{舌触|したざわ}り→舌触り：07919_shitazawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なめらかだ。
examples.english: Smooth bean paste has a silky texture.

examples.japanese: こしあん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮|に}て→煮る：01971_niru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{裏漉|うらご}し→裏漉し：23464_uragoshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To make smooth bean paste, you need to boil azuki beans and then strain them.

notes:
The name comes from ⟦{漉|こ}す→漉す：13512_kosu⟧ (to strain) + あん (sweet bean paste). Made by pressing cooked ⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧ beans through a sieve to remove the skins, then sweetening the resulting smooth paste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こしあん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧: yokan with smooth bean paste
- こしあん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧: manju with smooth bean paste
- こしあん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最中|もなか}→最中：28020_monaka⟧: monaka with smooth bean paste
- こしあん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たい{焼|や}き: taiyaki with smooth bean paste

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{粒|つぶ}あん→粒あん：20790_tsubuan⟧: chunky bean paste — beans are only partially mashed, retaining texture
- The こしあん vs ⟦{粒|つぶ}あん→粒あん：20790_tsubuan⟧ preference is a common conversation topic in Japan. Generally, こしあん is considered more refined and is preferred in many traditional ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as ⟦{漉|こ}し→漉す：13512_kosu⟧あん or {漉|こ}し{餡|あん}.

RELATED WORDS:
- あんこ: sweet bean paste (general term)
- ⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧: azuki beans
- ⟦{粒|つぶ}あん→粒あん：20790_tsubuan⟧: chunky bean paste
- {白|しろ}あん: white bean paste (made from white beans)
